The LeRoy W. Homer Jr. Scholarships

The [LeRoy W. Homer Jr. Foundation](https://leroywhomerjr.org/), named in honor of the first officer aboard United Airlines Flight 93, will hold its second annual 5K run and one-mile walk on September 7, in honor of the victims of the terrorist attacks on September 11, 2001.

This application is open for students starting at MSU in Fall, 2026! Please complete this application with details that highlight your potential to lead and your desire to earn a college degree. No Morelli-specific fields or eligibility identified by the public extraction.

Scholarship Recipients Will Receive Up to $15,000

Over 4 Years Seniors at Montana high schools who want to go to college now have more help in reaching that goal.

The program, administered by the Horatio Alger Association, is specifically for students who have confronted and overcome adversity in their young lives. Students from across Montana will be selected to each receive a $15,000 scholarship and have the honor of being named as a Horatio Alger Montana Scholar.

Scholarships can be utilized to pursue higher education at the University of Montana, Montana State University, or one of their affiliates:

University of Montana Western

Missoula College – University of Montana

Helena College – University of Montana

Montana Technological University in Butte

Montana State University Billings

Montana State University Northern

Great Falls College – Montana State University

The submission deadline to apply for the Horatio Alger Montana Undergraduate Scholarship Program is February 15th for high school seniors and March 1st for high school juniors.

How do I apply for the scholarship?

Applications are submitted only via the Horatio Alger Association’s application page during the window of December 1st to February 15th (for high school seniors) and December 1st to March 1st (for high school juniors).

If you have previously submitted an application to Horatio Alger for their National Scholarship, your application will automatically be considered for the Horatio Alger Dennis & Phyllis Washington Undergraduate Scholarship.

BE ENROLLED FULL TIME AS A HIGH SCHOOL SENIOR IN MONTANA, progressing toward graduation in Spring/Summer 2026, with plans to enter a college in the Montana University System no later than the fall following graduation.

BE INVOLVED in co-curricular, after school, or community activities.

DEMONSTRATE CRITICAL FINANCIAL NEED. Students of families who are eligible for the Pell Grant are strongly encouraged to apply.

DISPLAY INTEGRITY AND PERSEVERANCE in overcoming adversity.

BE A UNITED STATES CITIZEN.

PURSUE & COMPLETE A BACHELOR’S DEGREE IN THE MONTANA UNIVERSITY SYSTEM. Students may start their studies at a two-year institution and then transfer to a four-year institution. Eligible Institutions Include:

What universities participate in this scholarship program?

The University of Montana, or one of its afﬁliates:

Helena College

Missoula College

University of Montana Western (Dillon)

Montana Technological University (Butte)

Montana State University, or one of its afﬁliates:

Great Falls College – Montana State University

Montana State University Billings

Montana State University Northern (Havre)

All recipients must maintain a Grade Point Average (GPA) of 2.0 to keep their scholarship.

Montana State University is honored to announce a new investment in student support and scholarships through the generosity and vision of the Joseph James Legacy Foundation.

As of December 31, 2025, the Joseph James Morelli Legacy Foundation is dissolving and transferring to Montana State University, who is endowing a scholarship for Joseph James Morelli Scholars, students pursuing an education in STEM, in perpetuity. Starting in 2026, the scholarship is only available to students attending MSU.



MSU will continue the remarkable efforts of Joseph James Legacy Foundation by awarding the Hilleman/Morelli Scholarship. This 4-year scholarship provides a unique blend of financial, academic, leadership, and mentoring support for students. Beyond demonstrating learning differences, Hilleman/Morelli scholars will be selected on their academic, leadership, and career potential.

To apply or learn more about this Hilleman/Morelli scholarship, please visit the [Hilleman Scholars Application page](https://www.montana.edu/hillemanscholars/apply.html) for more information

The Joseph James Morelli Legacy Foundation supports high school and college students with dyslexia who wish to pursue a degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) field.

The Joseph James Morelli Legacy Foundation was established in 2014 to honor Joseph Morelli and support students with dyslexia who aspire to careers in STEM.

Timeline and Eligibility

Eligibility

Eagle Scouts may apply for NESA scholarships beginning in their senior year of high school through their junior year in an undergraduate program or by the halfway point of their associate degree program or skilled trade program.

NESA scholarships are available to Eagle Scouts currently enrolled in or accepted by an accredited educational institution as a full-time student (at least 12 credit hours) in a program leading to an academic degree (including associate degrees) or a skilled trade program.

Montana STEM / Healthcare Scholarship Program

Montana’s STEM/Healthcare Scholarship Program is designed to provide an incentive for Montana high school students to prepare for, enter into, and complete degrees in postsecondary fields related to science, technology, engineering, mathematics and healthcare. The goal of this program is to increase the number of STEM/Healthcare degree recipients participating in Montana’s workforce.

Awarded to seniors from high schools accredited by the Montana Board of Public Education Students who are awarded a scholarship and continue to meet the requirements may receive; $1,000 the first year, $1,500 the second year, $1,500 the third year and $2,000 the fourth year.

To receive $1,000 for the first academic year at a qualifying campus

Must obtain a cumulative high school GPA of at least 3.25

Must complete 4 years of college prep math and 3 years of college prep science by graduation

Must apply to and be accepted by one of the eligible campuses

Must be seeking a first certificate, or 2-year, or 4-year degree

STEM or Healthcare major

a minimum

Must enroll the first fall semester immediately following high school graduation
